t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It is important to ensure you are picking the gnome that you believe is likely to be the one that provides the best multiplier

vb_textbox.text: The game is good. You can choose between different coloured gnomes to decide what your multiplier will be. Take your time and try to understand any trends. In particular, you may want to pay attention to the sizes of mushrooms to ascertain if the size correlates to the reward received.
